integrity: The proof is elementary and complete. It reduces the Moran condition to the only possible prime quotient p, then solves the two-digit linear equation exactly. The Harshad extension follows by exhausting the divisors 1,p,p^2 of p^2. Finite computation is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only the two-digit regime p<B<=p^2. It makes no classification claim for B<=p. The 2010 primary mathematical paper inspected here is dated only by month; to avoid inventing a day, the stored date is the earliest exact public release date verified for an arbitrary-radix Moran source.
title: Two-digit prime-square base spectrum for Harshad and Moran numbers
